title: Back Loop Only Ribbing
description: Create stretch and visible ridges by working into one loop instead of both.

content.summary: Back loop only crochet changes the texture of the fabric and creates a clean ribbed look.
content.whyItMatters: This technique is used in beanies, cuffs, and textured basics where stretch and direction matter.
steps: Find the two top loops of a stitch and identify the back loop farthest from you.
Insert the hook under only that back loop instead of both loops.
Work the stitch normally while keeping the edge relaxed.
Repeat across the row to build even ridges.
content.practice: Work two short rows in regular stitches, then two rows in back loop only and compare the texture.
commonMistakes: Accidentally grabbing both loops out of habit.
Pulling too tightly and making the ribbing stiff instead of flexible.
